# Test fixtures

These image files are generated by `crates/unqimages-core/examples/generate_fixtures.rs`.
They are intentionally simple, small, and deterministic so tests remain fast and stable.

## Regenerate

```bash
cargo run --example generate_fixtures
```

## Contents

- `exact/dupe-a.png` and `exact/dupe-b.png` — byte-identical PNGs.
- `exact/unique.png` — a visually distinct PNG.
- `perceptual/original.png` — base image for perceptual tests.
- `perceptual/compressed.jpg` — the same image saved as a JPEG, used to detect
  visual duplicates across formats/compression.
- `perceptual/different.png` — a visually distinct PNG.
- `mixed/dupe.webp` — WebP copy of the exact duplicate image.
- `unsupported/file.txt` — a non-image file that discovery must ignore.
